title: Victorian hallway
alt: Timber stairs beside a black and cream geometric tiled hallway.
description: This customer has come back to us more than once. For their hallway we lifted the old floor, levelled the joists, laid a new subfloor and tiled it in a Victorian pattern. The skirting came off and went back on around the new floor.

title: Kitchen fit-out
alt: A U-shaped kitchen with dark cabinets, timber worktops, a white sink and a star-patterned floor.
description: We stripped this kitchen back to the concrete walls and subfloor, keeping only the window. Then came a new subfloor, plasterboard and skim, the tiled floor, cabinets, worktop, appliances and splashback.

title: Georgian office fit-out
alt: A Georgian entrance with a dark stair runner, blue armchair and globe pendant.
description: A full fit-out of a three-storey-over-basement Georgian building on Fitzwilliam Square, with its protected plasterwork preserved or reinstated. We took the entrance hall back to the joists, replaced the rotten ones and laid a natural Italian stone floor. Rooms became offices, with new bathrooms, a full rewire and replumb, a fire system and emergency lighting.

title: Victorian bathroom
alt: A Victorian-style tiled floor seen through an open door, with a terracotta and charcoal border.
description: A Victorian-style bathroom. We took the floor back to the subfloor, retiled it and fitted out the room.

title: Georgian bathroom
alt: Two white basin cabinets beneath a wide mirror above a black and white patterned floor.
description: Bathrooms for an office on Fitzwilliam Square. We did the first fix, the pipes and cables that go in before the walls are finished, then tiled floor to ceiling in subway tiles. Modern fittings went in, with made-to-measure cabinets and mirrors.

title: Apartment fit-out
alt: An apartment bathroom with a curved shower enclosure, dark textured walls and a geometric floor.
description: A full fit-out of an apartment on Adelaide Road, with a new kitchen and bathroom. In the bathroom, a curved shower enclosure leaves space at the centre of the floor.
